contrast.title: Contrast
contrast.sample: Normal text reads like this on the background
contrast.passes: The color already passes this level
contrast.none: Not even black or white reaches this level on this background
contrast.noneTranslucent: The text is too transparent to reach this level on this background; make it more opaque

vision.title: Color blindness
vision.note: How the color looks without red cones (protanopia), green cones (deuteranopia), blue cones (tritanopia) or any color vision (achromatopsia)

errors.unknown: This is not a CSS color. Try a hex code like #3b82f6, a color function like rgb() or oklch(), or a color name
